elaine: Quick heads-up — I ran the weekly privilege heatmap across prod projects. Found ~42 high-risk admins and ~17 ownerless service roles.

sam: Ugh. Are the ownerless ones mostly old CI jobs?

elaine: ~60% look like old deploy agents. A few are cross-account bindings to our data-pipeline GCP project.

devon: Can you paste the query you used? I want to run it scoped to eu-west.

elaine: Sure, here's the listing command I used for GCP IAM bindings (trimmed):
```
# list principals with Owner/Editor perms by project
gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json > policy.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role | test("Owner|Editor|roles/.*Admin"))' policy.json
```

katie: For KMS-integrated keys we should correlate key ACLs too — ran into a case last month where a rotated key still had old svcacct grants.

elaine: Good call. I pulled KMS grants with this quick API check:
```
aws kms list-grants --key-id alias/ci-deploy | jq '.Grants[] | {GranteePrincipal,Operations}'
```
Found 3 grants to principals that are not in our identity directory.

security-bot: AUTOMATED: Privilege heatmap completed for 12 projects. 42 HIGH, 128 MEDIUM, 230 LOW. Remediation playbook: https://redwood.internal/rbac-remediate

sam: Proposed next steps: 1) short owner hunt for those 17 ownerless roles (tag + 48h), 2) schedule an automated temporary-removal canary for 5% of high-risk admins, 3) open tickets for KMS grant revocations where principal unknown.

devon: I can take the canary. I'll add a runbook entry and coordinate with eng-oncall for the 9–11am window. Need explicit rollback steps.

katie: For the owner hunt, can we add a policy that requires an oncall email on role metadata? The audit logs show sometimes humans forget to set owner.

elaine: We can't retroactive-add metadata without owners, but we can add a short enforcement hook going forward and a lint job that fails CI on infra diffs lacking owner tags. I'll draft the infra PR.

sam: Also flagging potential audit log gap: a few KMS grant events between 2610000000–2611000000 had missing requester fields. Filing a security incident ticket to correlate with infra deploys.

security-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Missing KMS requester metadata detected. Please add logs or traces to ticket #SEC-879.

elaine: Cool. I'll create the tickets and the heatmap artifact. Devon — ping me when you schedule the canary so I can freeze related rollouts.

devon: Will do. ETA for canary schedule and runbook by EOD tomorrow.

katie: I'll start the owner-hunt play and run the identity reconciliation script against the suspect principals.

elaine: Thanks team. Small side ask — if you see role binds with long-lived keys, call them out in the ticket. Those will likely need KMS grant rotation + rebind. :thumbsup:
